title: LLM Recovery Proposal
description: A single constrained proposal from the LLM recovery agent. The LLM proposes and interprets only; it never drives actuators and never asserts numeric feasibility (MISSION.md §7). Every field is enforced at the token level via llama.cpp grammar-constrained decoding.

mode.description: Requested recovery mode. Constrained to the fixed state-machine vocabulary (MISSION.md §8). The arbiter validates the transition; the LLM may only request.

rationale.description: Short human-readable justification citing evidence. Bounded so a runaway generation cannot fill the log.

requested_checks.description: Diagnostic/verification steps the LLM asks the numerical planner & validator to run before its plan is accepted. The LLM cannot mark these as passed. Unique members only.

parameters.description: Action parameters. All numeric fields are bounded; the validator re-checks them against real dynamics. The LLM may propose, never assert.
